relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: The latency to the thermal stimulus (18.11 ± 1.36 s) in the LPS-treated mice was significantly decreased by 30% compared with saline-treated mice

key_findings: Bexarotene (10 mg/kg) prevented LPS-induced thermal hyperalgesia in mice.
Bexarotene reversed LPS-induced loss of RXRα and rise of TLR4, MyD88, p-TAK1, NF-κB p65, COX-2, IL-1β and PGE2 in brain and spinal cord.
